name: EmComm Tools Example LXST server
motd: Welcome to an example Partyline LXST server for EmComm Tools.
_comment_access_: An optional server-wide password, an allow list of identity hashes, or both. 'hidden' keeps the server out of browsers.
_comment_ops_: Operators can kick, ban, mute, move and promote users from their client. More can be promoted at run time.
_comment_dialin_: Answer rnphone calls to this server's identity hash and put callers in a room.
_comment_profiles_: Codec profiles are: opus-high, opus-med, opus-low, c2-3200, c2-2400, c2-1200, c2-700, music-low, music-med, music-high

rooms.name: Low bandwidth room
rooms.description: Low bitrate room for slow links

rooms.name: Broadcast
rooms.description: Music/broadcast room. Only listed identities in music, seperated by comma, may broadcast
